phase: body reconstruction implemented and statically verified

implementation.visibility: private interior continuation only; no standalone callable export
implementation.receiver: No public receiver argument; the live address is reached only by conditional branches from 0x007e6100.
implementation.continuation_state: A call-local RAII record carries the saved ESI input pointer, the output pointer represented by the live ESP+0x10 slot, and the first-comparison carry.
implementation.return_type: AL 0/1 on the interior exit paths

observed_original_abi.calling_convention: interior continuation of the cdecl-shaped 0x007e6100 body; not a standalone call
observed_original_abi.hidden_receiver: No public receiver parameter; ECX is comparison state established by 0x007e6100 and is not the SDK this pointer.

inherited_register_state.ESI: pointer to the first string argument saved by 0x007e6100
inherited_register_state.CF: carry from the first byte comparison at 0x007e6112 or 0x007e6120
inherited_register_state.stack_output_slot: the saved group_ids pointer is read at ESP+0x10 after the PUSH ESI at the live continuation entry

observed_original_abi.internal_cleanup: POP ESI followed by plain RET on all exits; this unwinds the interior frame and is not a public-call cleanup contract.
observed_original_abi.ghidra_boundary_note: The address is a branch target that Ghidra exposes as a separate function entry, but its machine state depends on the preceding function and it has no direct callers.

mechanics.first_carry: If the first comparison carried equality, write 0x0153f864 to the inherited output pointer, set AL to 1, and return.
mechanics.second_match: Call 16 no-argument service ports and store EAX results in output offsets 0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x0c, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24, 0x2c, 0x30, 0x34, 0x38, 0x28, 0x3c.
mechanics.mismatch: Return with AL cleared without writing the output buffer or calling a service port.
mechanics.null_behavior: The inherited string and output pointers have no null guards; invalid pointers fault only on the corresponding read or write path.

live_provenance.analysis_basis: Read-only live Ghidra queries against the open x86:LE:32 program.
live_provenance.decompile: The live decompiler shows the carry-dependent first branch followed by the GetAppPluginServices comparison and 16 service calls.
live_provenance.disassembly: The live range begins with SBB EAX,EAX; SBB EAX,-1 and ends with XOR AL,AL or MOV AL,1, POP ESI, RET.
live_provenance.global_evidence: 0x01413874 contains GetAppPluginServices and 0x0153f864 is the first-match output constant.

runtime_gate.condition: Observe the actual incoming ESI, carry, output pointer, service return values, and concrete service owners in an original-process call path.
